# Test fixtures

`zh-data-structures/` is a copy of the sample course shipped with
[universal-examprep-skill / Exam Cram Coach](https://github.com/ZeKaiNie/universal-examprep-skill)
(MIT, © ZeKaiNie). It is vendored here so the test suite is self-contained and can run
offline; it is not modified. The CLI acceptance smoke test also runs directly against
the original sample under `research/skill-repo/samples/`.
